Your app’s Moon altitude of **−51.9°** means the Moon is far below your horizon, so it is physically impossible to see from Perth regardless of clear skies, darkness, eyesight, or knowing where to look.

The **5.75% illuminated** crescent would also be quite challenging even if it were above the horizon, especially only about **27.7° from the Sun**. But the decisive issue is simply that it has already set (or has not yet risen, depending on its motion at that time).
